I break down exactly how a 14-year-old is pulling in $100k per month in profit by building apps with AI, focusing on what actually drives downloads and revenue. I explain why distribution over product matters more than perfection, and how viral apps win by nailing mobile app marketing and a clear app growth strategy from day one.

I show how tiktok app marketing fuels installs using viral marketing, viral trends, and a repeatable tiktok growth strategy that leverages ugc creators and faceless content. This approach works especially well for consumer apps and ai apps, even if you’re building no code apps or starting as one of many indie app founders.

I also cover real app monetization tactics, including ad monetized apps, and how to think about app distribution and app store growth without burning cash. You’ll hear practical startup lessons pulled from the creator economy, build in public, and insights you’d expect from a top founder podcast—all centered on trend riding instead of chasing hype.

If you’re serious about growth, this is a clear playbook for turning ideas into traction.
